name: sign by adding the hash of (commitment, message) times the secret to the nonce
mechanism: derive a nonce from the secret and the message, publish its commitment, and output nonce plus hash(commitment, public key, message) times the secret; the verifier checks that the generator raised to that sum equals the commitment times the public key raised to the same hash; no inversion is needed and the check is one linear relation

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'EdDSA (Ed25519)' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

requires: a hash of commitment, key and message
fails_when: a fault during nonce derivation reveals the key
